lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Hello! ☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: We're ☆Reverie☆ who

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: delivers love and dreams to everyone in the Ark ★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Are you ☆Commander★?

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: The one who carries the hopes and dreams of those who entrust you with a task?
I'm not sure I'd go that far.
I'm just a Commander, nothing more.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Oh, come on now☆ Don't be shy★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: You may not know it, but I do know of

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: your real identity as a Dream Protector!
... Anyway, what is it you want?

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Oh☆ That's right! ★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Here I am jabbering on with introductions☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Everybody knows if you don't cut to the chase,

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: your viewers will flee in droves!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: ☆But nobody's perfect★
Aren't you going to make a request?

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Sheesh☆ What's the rush?★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: You're not exactly what I picture when I think of a heroic protagonist.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Having said that, you do have a certain kind of appeal.
All right, we're done here.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Just a minute! My request is very, very simple★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: All those poor souls fighting for their lives in that hellish landscape above us.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: They have everything I want!!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Passion! Brutality! Energy! Action!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: I want a piece of that!
You want us to film it?

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Exactly☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: You and the Nikkes coming together to fight for all humanity

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: in a battle to reclaim the surface.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Life! Death! Passion!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: And a touch of romance!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Who can ask for more?☆
Why do you want this footage?

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: It'll be perfect for the new series I'm producing☆
... A TV series?

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Yes☆ It's gonna be a smash hit.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: It follows a rookie Commander and

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: a veteran band of Nikkes as they struggle to stay alive up on the surface.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Not forgetting to throw a love story or two in for good measure.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Sure, this story concept may not be original.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: But every other series before this have all faked the battle scenes

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: with unconvincing CGI, leaving the audiences cold.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text:
"The surface... our home... it's all gone.
But it will forever live on in our memories."

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: "It's all she ever wanted."

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: These corny screenplays make me want to hurl!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: But I'm different. I'm nothing like those inferior peeps★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: I won't short-change my viewers with sloppy CGI-laden battle scenes.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Of course, in order to accomplish that,

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: I'll have to go film the real McCoy☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Unfortunately, I don't have the authority to do that.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: So, I'll have to improvise☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: If I can't go, someone else can in my stead★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: ☆Commander★ My hopes and dreams lie in the palm of your hand.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Won't you help me?★
War is not a game.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: But why keep it hidden from everyone, adults included?

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Don't they deserve to know what war is really like?★
You do have a point...
Well... I'm still not sure.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Hehehe★ I'm glad you're starting to see things my way☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: ★Very well... Why don't you mull it over for a second☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Now is the time to decide.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Will you do it?
I can try.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Hehe☆ you truly are the ☆Dream Protector★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Oh, right☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Come to think of it, it nearly slipped my mind...

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: ☆DO★NOT☆FORGET★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: When you're filming, I want you and the Nikkes together in the same frame, got it?★
Me?

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Of course★ It's absolutely crucial!☆★☆★☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: I can't go without it! ★☆★☆★☆★☆★☆★☆
Understood.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: All right, I'll be waiting☆
